mapper.select: SELECT ddovyo.id, t.dates, t.pkg, t.version, t.user_source, t.active_user_num, t.active_event_ltv, t.active_user_ltv, t.new_user_num, t.new_user_event_ltv, t.new_user_ltv FROM (SELECT dqlr.dates, dqlr.pkg, dqlr.version, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Unknow') user_source, COUNT(distinct dqlr.user_id) active_user_num, SUM(dqlr.event_ltv) active_event_ltv, SUM(dqlr.user_ltv) active_user_ltv, COUNT(distinct dui.user_id) new_user_num, SUM(dqlr.event_ltv) new_user_event_ltv, SUM(dqlr.user_ltv) new_user_ltv FROM dwd_qp_ltv_record dqlr LEFT JOIN dim_user_info dui on (dui.user_id = dqlr.user_id and dui.dates = dqlr.dates) left join dim_user_source dus on (dus.user_id = dqlr.user_id) where dqlr.dates = #{dates} GROUP BY dqlr.dates, dqlr.pkg, dqlr.version, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Unknow')) t left join dws_daily_pkg_ver_usrc_qp_ltv ddovyo on (t.dates = ddovyo.dates and t.pkg = ddovyo.pkg and t.version = ddovyo.version and t.user_source = ddovyo.user_source)
